summary: The AdHocQuery file defines a static C# class for converting a SqlDataReader's data into an HTML table. It systematically generates table headers, rows, and footers by iterating over the fields and rows of the data reader, rendering null values as 'NULL' and ensuring all values are HTML-encoded inside table cells.
purpose: To transform SQL query results (from SqlDataReader) into an HTML table representation for display purposes.

workflows.name: DataReaderToHTMLTable generation
steps: Append HTML table header using field names
Iterate through each row in SqlDataReader
For each field, check for NULL or value and append table data cell accordingly

business_rules: Render NULL for any database null values
Wrap each row in <tr> and each field in <td>
Table always uses class 'help-table' and border=1
conditions: If dr.IsDBNull(i), render 'NULL'; else, render value
system_behavior: Returns the complete HTML table as a string for rendering
content_gaps: No explicit handling for SQL or HTML injection
No mention of HTML encoding for special characters
